subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should OpenClaw use the existing prompt-send `erroredAssistantResultPolicy: "drop"` behavior for aborted assistant tool-call turns before built-in compaction summarization?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but dropping an aborted assistant turn trades a small amount of context for strict-provider validity, so the permanent session-state policy should be accepted by a maintainer rather than inferred from automation alone.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR with the existing drop behavior because it aligns compaction with prompt-send replay and prevents strict-provider session corruption.

options.title: Request synthetic/ambiguous recovery
options.body: Ask for a different policy that preserves an interrupted turn with explicit synthetic or unknown-status context, accepting more implementation and product-review work before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader compaction policy
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers define one policy for built-in and pluggable compaction providers, delaying the active fix for the linked bug.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR with the existing drop behavior because it aligns compaction with prompt-send replay and prevents strict-provider session corruption.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the shared compaction and transcript-repair surfaces where this policy lives.
